Alex — thanks for the clear asks and the partial intake. Looping in Neha and Rishi internally to confirm the final artifact set, but quick answers below and a proposed package: 

1) Notification windows: our standard operational commitment is to acknowledge incidents to affected customers within 4 hours of detection and to issue a customer notification within 12 hours for incidents classified as "critical" (data exfiltration, confirmed PHI exposure, or service-impacting breaches). We can align contractually to a 24-hour initial notification window if needed — that is within our operational capability.

2) Substantive updates/full report: for critical incidents we provide substantive technical updates within 72 hours and a more complete root-cause and remediation report within 30 days. We can commit to Sundial’s preference for a 7-day substantive update as part of a tailored SLA.

3) Artifacts we can share pre-NDA: redacted SOC2 Type II summary (control coverage and test period), IR-runbook excerpt (customer notification flow and escalation matrix), and a BCP/DR overview that includes high-level RTO/RPO targets for the inference service. Full SOC2 report or raw evidence requires an NDA and formal request.

4) Timeline: assuming Neha signs off, we can provide the redacted SOC2 summary, IR-runbook excerpt, and BCP overview by EOD Tuesday 2026-12-07. We will include a sample customer notification template you can adapt.

Attachments we will send: SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf (redacted), IR-runbook-excerpt.pdf, BCP-overview.pdf, AIA-signed-template.docx (for legal to review). I’ve uploaded a draft packet to our shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Sundial-IR-pack (see related links).

5) Contract/Legal: we typically require a signed DPA/AIA before exchanging the full SOC2 report. DocuSign link to the standard AIA is: https://docusign.com/some-dpa-link. If you prefer an NDA first, we can route that as well.

If that timeline works I’ll assemble the packet and Marissa can schedule the 12/8 follow-up.
